_meta.purpose: B1 experiment: deliberately vague NL descriptions that strip the entity types, parameter cues, and domain qualifiers present in the main-line descriptions. Goal: make the Discoverer NATURALLY generate flawed specs (wrong types, vague param names, missing distinctions), so the Optimizer has real — not injected — defects to fix.
_meta.isolation: Lives under data/lowqual/. Does NOT touch data/tool_descriptions.json or any main-line artifact.
_meta.pairing: Each item maps to a main-line tool so we can compare baseline accuracy of the rich spec vs. the low-quality spec.

tools.lowqual: a tool that gets paper text from an id
tools.rich_reference: a tool that fetches the abstract of a PubMed paper given its PMID

tools.lowqual: a tool that returns problems for a thing by name
tools.rich_reference: a tool that gets known side effects of a drug given the drug name

tools.lowqual: a tool that converts one code to another code
tools.rich_reference: a tool that converts a gene symbol to its Ensembl gene ID

tools.lowqual: a tool that compares two items and returns a number
tools.rich_reference: a tool that calculates the Tanimoto similarity between two molecules given their SMILES strings

tools.lowqual: a tool that looks up a structure by an id
tools.rich_reference: a tool that retrieves protein 3D structure given a PDB ID
